hypothesis: Scoring the MTP head's drafts over an adaptive list of the most used tokens (16000 and the conversation's) with the rows of the lm_head already on the card, instead of the whole 248320-token vocabulary, raises Qwen3.6's decode with the head's drafts on an L4 with every expert in VRAM, with the same logits (code, one draft a step).
